notes.title: Spark Update
notes.notes: Onboarding rework, Many bugfix, Quality of Life improvements

notes.title: The Spark update!
notes.notes:
Our new update is live!

After reviewing your feedback and suggestions, we've made some changes! Many of you mentioned that the phone conversations were too long, the combat phases too. So we changed that and fixed a few bugs!

Added

 New transition screen system + animations
 Message discussions now with the Restaurant background
 "Parenthesis" in dialogue choices to understand the emotion and tone of a decision
 English Localization for the dialogue choices "Parenthesis"
 New input control for phone dialogue


Updated

 Delay before lasting effects
 New versions of the lasting effects icons
 Relationship episodes (Will & Mom) condition changed
 UI text now displays the total amount of damage dealt/healed
 Switch "Quit" and "New game" button in settings > saves screen


Fixed

 Issue with "Confuse" VFX not displaying properly
 Lasting effects icon sizes
 Power durations for all heroes
 Combat boss 01 miscellaneous fixes
 Navigation issue on Setting app
 Relationship episodes consent event fix and parse + loca + addressable + some staging corrections
 Wish one-liners hotfix: fixed the lines not playing only one time
 "First Date" achievement unlockable
 Add the lasting effect icons in the power description
 Phone apps wait until fully loaded


We're always reading carefully your feedback and reports, so feel free to share them on the Steam discussions! And leave us a review, it helps us a lot ♥

notes.title: What's in the next update?
notes.notes:
An update is on the way for the first chapter The Spark!

We've been carefully reading your feedback and thanks to your reports and suggestions, a few things will be updated! This update will come in the first week of March.

Here is our plan for this update:

 Fasten the conversation in the Message App
 Modify the combat pacing to have fewer combats and fasten them
 Specify the intentions behind dialogue choices
 Many other quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44835526/ee86b59158ef5f035b6f376213c05b2623112fd5.png

Thanks to YOU, we can improve this game, so don't hesitate to share your feedback and suggestions in the Steam discussions.

What would you like to see improved in the game?
